How's it going? A necklace that is not forgotten is equal to a necklace that is forgotten. Just as he is in the neck, but if he is forgotten, he seems to be unattained. Not only that, but for the unsatisfied yogis, who are devoted to the satisfaction of the senses, and who are disguised as yogis, both here and in the next life are unhappiness and suffering. That is, he argues, from the unresolved death of the unreturned death. There is so much suffering in this world because of the troubles of worshiping the world, earning wealth, etc., and because of the fear of being revealed in pleasure, glory and other things. Your suffering is even worse than God’s. How about from the ghost? From the unridden term, from the unridden term which has the form. Because of the lack of attainment of Your transcendental form, which is like ignorance, which is the object of transgression of one’s own religious principles, one is bound to attain hell in the form of punishment. A man deprived of the sheep of punishment and trust, anxious only for pleasure Day and night he was bewildered and overwhelmed by the fatigue of his unprepared industry. The ignorant, the ignorant, the disobedient, the ignorant, the respectless, the mad O Lord of the poor, O treasure of mercy, O Lord of supreme bliss, protect me.

तत्र ननु कथम् अवगन्तुं शक्यते, दुरधिगमत्वस्योक्तत्वात् ? — How can it be understood there, since it is said to be difficult to reach?; इत्य् एवम् आशङ्क्य सत्यम् एवम् अनवगाह्य-महिम्नो वाङ्-मनसागोचरत्वाद् अविषयत्वेनइव ज्ञानम् इति दर्शयन्, — It is thus suspected, showing that truth is thus knowledge of the inscrutable glory, since it is visible to speech and mind,; हे भगवन्, ते अन्तं द्यु-पतयः स्वर्गादि-लोक-पतयो ब्रह्मादयो न ययुर् न प्रापुः । — O Lord, the lords of the heavens, the lords of the heavenly planets, the lords of the heavenly planets, the lords of Brahmā and others, did not go to that end, nor did they reach it.;
